description: This file defines the DataGroupDao class, which is a Data Access Object (DAO) responsible for querying and retrieving data related to DataGroup and DataGroupPermission entities from the database. It provides methods for fetching data groups by name, permissions by data group and user role, API permissions, filtered data group permissions, and listing all data groups.

classes.name: DataGroupDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class extending BaseDao to handle operations related to DataGroup and DataGroupPermission entities, including retrieval by name, user role, API permissions, and permission filtering.

methods.name: getDataGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a DataGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Gets permissions associated with specified data groups and user role, optionally filtered for self-permissions.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Fetches data group permissions for a specified API class name and a list of roles, which can be role objects or role names.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves data group permissions filtered based on provided parameters, including accessibility and API data groups.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Returns all DataGroup entities ordered by description.
